status: Efficiency investigation complete; formal training remains on hold

baseline.note: CUDA event stage spans include CPU dispatch gaps and synchronization; vision includes preprocessing. Short real-data profile, not a full epoch. Throughput is total samples divided by total elapsed logging intervals after warmup.

batch5_trial.result: CUDA OOM in language model first training forward; no successful optimizer step
batch5_trial.recommendation: Retain per-GPU batch 4 for the current implementation; the direct increase to 5 is not viable with the tested configuration.

frozen_vision_cache_candidate.note: Theoretical ceiling inferred from measured stage fractions, not a measured speedup. Build cost, storage metadata, cache I/O and partial-batch efficiency are not included. Image augmentation share is separate from the 30/70 prompt mix.
frozen_vision_cache_candidate.semantics: Only deterministic unaugmented frozen-vision outputs can be reused. Keep augmented samples online and keep the trainable visual adapter, language LoRA and progress head online. All validation images are unaugmented.
frozen_vision_cache_candidate.recommended_next_step: Small cache proof-of-concept with feature/loss parity and throughput tests before bulk precomputation.

recommendations: Do not add DataLoader workers as the first optimization: steady-state data wait is already below 0.1%.
Prioritize the frozen-vision cache proof-of-concept while preserving augmentation semantics.
Leave formal 8-GPU / 12-epoch / save-every-2-epoch run paused pending the user decision.
